actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '\nTOOLS:\n'
command -v python3 || true
command -v python || true
command -v curl || true
command -v wget || true
command -v yt-dlp || true
command -v youtube-dl || true
command -v ffmpeg || true
command -v ffprobe || true
printf '\nROOT LISTING:\n'
ls -la /app || true
ls -la . || true
